answer: Tie each agent to one e-passport chip. The agent taps its passport, the chip signs a fresh nonce with its country-signed key, and the network checks the signature against the ICAO public key directory, keeping only a hash. One passport backs one agent, and a random quarterly recheck lands at dawn and demands a new chip signature within 24 hours. A miss burns a 250 POA bond and freezes the identity for 30 days. Forging 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real passports at about $165 each, $165,000 before one earns. A sybil farm is an orchard of paper trees, but each ivory page holds one real name.
